objective: Verify a support note's claim about a Tikkurila product by locating its catalog record and confirming whether the claimed product type and color family properties are present.

params.product_query: Search the product catalog for variants where brand is Tikkurila and the product line matches Tikkurila Exterior TIK 3PN-569 Wood Stain and Deck Oil, then inspect the associated product properties for product type primer and color families White and brown

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Catalog check result for SKU {sku} at {record_path}: claim status reported
